# ReproMeta

A unified R interface for assessing replication success across multiple 
statistical frameworks.

## Installation
```r
devtools::install_gitlab("your-username/ReproMeta")
```

## Quick Start
```r
library(ReproMeta)

assess_replication_outcome(
  r_o = 0.35, n_o = 100,
  r_r = 0.21, n_r = 120,
  effectsize = "COR",
  metric = c("significance_r", "pScept", "BFr")
)
```
